categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Wallet' and modifies descriptor handling and keypool refill bounds in src/wallet/scriptpubkeyman.cpp and src/wallet/imports.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes node assertion aborts and signed integer overflows triggered during descriptor import and keypool top-ups. As reported in the description, importing descriptors with range end 2^31-1 'narrows to a negative value and aborts the node during keypool top-up,' and keypoolrefill INT32_MAX triggers signed integer overflow under UBSan.
